audit.why: 43.55% over 1286 games; packet chart is Irelia on all seven rows and both layers agree. The mirror audit also left the chart alone.

audit.whatIsWrong: Every stage attributes Irelia's lead to a W 'shield' rather than to Bladesurge resets and the Flawless Duet stun, so the reader waits for the wrong cooldown before committing.
audit.why: Cooldowns: Q 10/9/8/7/6s with a refresh on Marked or killed targets, W 20/18/16/14/12s, E 16/14.5/13/11.5/10s, R 125/105/85s.
audit.corrected: spikes[0..2], mid and late now hang the stage on the reset and on Flawless Duet's 16s rank-1 cooldown.

audit.whatIsWrong: Defiant Dance is called a shield in five places and credited with absorbing Soul Ignition's burst. It is not a shield and it does not touch your damage: it reduces PHYSICAL damage taken while she charges, and Locke's kit is magic plus true damage.
audit.why: Riot text: 'Irelia charges a strike that deals more damage as she charges. She takes reduced physical damage during the charge.' Locke's passive is magic on-hit and Soul Ignition is flagged true damage.
audit.corrected: Corrected in whys[2], spikes[0].text, spikes[1].text, spikes[2].text, mid, late and wants.foe[1] — the advice 'bait her W before you commit' was costing the reader the trade for no reason.

audit.whatIsWrong: Flawless Duet's grounding was never mentioned, and wants.you[2] told the reader to 'E away from her stun'. Inside the blades you are grounded — Ashen Pursuit does not fire.
audit.why: Kit flags on Irelia E: grounding, hardCC, zone, 850 range.
audit.corrected: Written into spikes[0].text, mid, report[5].t, wants.you[1] and wants.you[2].

audit.why: packet.suspectNames flagged 'Her Vanguard's Edge' — a false positive from the possessive; the name is right.

edits.before: Level 3 is Irelia with Defiant Dance (W) shielding your damage.
edits.after: Level 3 is Irelia — her Q reset sticks to you through the wave.

edits.before: Irelia snowballs the moment she has stacks — Bladesurge (Q) resets off minions and your body, Defiant Dance (W) gives a huge damage-reduction shield through your combo, and Flawless Duet (E) stuns you out of any all-in.
edits.after: Irelia snowballs the moment she has stacks — Bladesurge (Q) resets off minions and your body, Defiant Dance (W) cuts only physical damage so it does nothing to your magic, and Flawless Duet (E) grounds and stuns you out of any all-in.

edits.before: Her Vanguard's Edge (R) wall zones your Purgatory (R) and cuts you off; she can Q-reset onto you and W-tank your W Soul Ignition burst so your execute rarely gets the finish.
edits.after: Vanguard's Edge (R, 125s) Marks you and leaves a slowing wall, so she Q-resets onto the mark and your execute rarely gets the finish. Her W will not blunt your magic — her resets will.

edits.before: Irelia out-scales your early spike as a reset-duelist — her sustained on-hit plus W shield beats your one-combo burst, and she stat-checks you the moment she's ahead.
edits.after: Irelia out-scales your early spike as a reset-duelist — her on-hit stacking and Bladesurge healing beat your one-combo burst, and she stat-checks you the moment she's ahead.

edits.before: Through 6 she stays ahead. Defiant Dance (W) shields straight through your W Soul Ignition combo, and her Vanguard's Edge (R) wall can cut off your Purgatory execute and Q-reset her onto you. Only commit if her W and E are both down, otherwise she stat-checks the all-in.
edits.after: Through 6 she stays ahead. Defiant Dance (W) only reduces physical damage, so your combo lands in full — the real problem is Flawless Duet (E, 16s at rank 1), which grounds and stuns, and the R wall that Marks you for a Q reset. Commit only once her E is spent.

edits.before: With items Irelia remains favoured — she's a reset-fuelled duelist whose on-hit and shielding out-value your burst-execute pattern. Play safe, look to roam or group, and pick her only when she's already used W and E rather than dueling her head-on.
edits.after: With items Irelia remains favoured — she's a reset-fuelled duelist whose on-hit and Bladesurge healing out-value your burst-execute pattern. Play safe, look to roam or group, and pick her only once Flawless Duet is spent rather than dueling head-on.

edits.before: Track Irelia’s Flawless Duet (Stun): Her stun setup — dodge it and the dive falls apart. Commit only while it is down.
edits.after: Flawless Duet (16s at rank 1) stuns and grounds between the blades — Ashen Pursuit will not fire inside it, so dodge, don't dash.

notes: Defiant Dance was treated as a shield that eats your combo in five places. It reduces physical damage only, and Locke deals magic and true — so the page's 'bait her W first' advice was throwing away trades for nothing. The other correction is Flawless Duet's grounding: the page told the reader to E out of the stun, which is exactly what the ability prevents.
